label: BGP
notes: BGP-4 message header over TCP port 179. The 19-byte fixed header is modelled; the message body that follows (OPEN, UPDATE, NOTIFICATION, KEEPALIVE, ROUTE-REFRESH payload) is variable-length and not modelled. The 16-byte marker exceeds the 4-byte BPF load window and is normally all ones; it is excluded. The anchor base 20 assumes a TCP header without options, the same fixed-header convention as the IP anchor.

fields.label: Total Message Length
fields.description: Total length of the BGP message including the 19-byte header; 19 for a bare KEEPALIVE, at most 4096.

excluded.reason: 16-byte marker: wider than the 4-byte BPF load window; sent as all ones (RFC 4271 section 4.1) and carries no filtering value
